title: OpenJev (Qwen3.5 4B) is now available on Unity Gateway
body:
[OpenJev (Qwen3.5 4B)](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#openjev-qwen35-4b) is available as a pay-per-token model service. Use the [TypeSafe System One API](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/query-systemone-models) to evaluate yes or no, choice, and scoring questions and get structured answers and probabilities. See [model availability by region](/aws/en/unity-gateway/model-region-availability).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable model terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
